cards.decision_boundary: Default repair sequencing may omit a reachable, bounded repair-power phase even though the policy implementation exists.
cards.summary: Revalidate whether the implicit/default repair sequence reaches early forced reclaim; keep explicit custom schedules unchanged and require retained-move telemetry before claiming activation.

cards.decision_boundary: Candidate generation and a journal-backed timing-window commit are separate boundaries; a ranking change is not evidence unless candidates are generated and retained.
cards.summary: Focus on an early-reclaim candidate path that produces a measurable candidate/commit transition while preserving existing legality, max-cap, timing rollback, and zero-DRV constraints.

cards.decision_boundary: A reversible local measurement path is useful only if the optimizer dispatch can reach it under the evaluated default flow.
cards.summary: Revalidate dispatch and retained-move signals before refining measured power candidate ranking; do not treat a historical mechanism description as current QoR evidence.
